synchronous_read_assessment.rtl_behavior: A request registers row addresses on one edge; on the following edge the clocked block dereferences all eight bank arrays into a FIFO slot. Independent VCS checked response == prior-cycle issue.
synchronous_read_assessment.scoped_wording_admitted: one-cycle registered eight-bank array read interface

ii_scope_audit.equation: 1600 always-ready phases * 127 within-phase adjacent descriptor intervals
ii_scope_audit.conclusion: The II result is valid only inside preloaded always-ready phases; it is not a module-cycle or throughput result.

findings.title: Payload and descriptor valids can silently deadlock each other
findings.evidence: descriptor_ready is gated by !payload_load_valid while payload_load_ready is gated by !descriptor_valid. The independent bench held both valids for four cycles and observed ready=accept=busy=protocol_error=0 throughout.
findings.impact: Two legal ready/valid producers can wedge the frontend without a fault or documented arbitration contract.
findings.minimal_fix: Give one channel explicit priority or add a phase-state FSM; alternatively assert and fail closed on simultaneous valids and state the producer protocol in the contract.

findings.title: The 203200 II counter excludes the serialized phase loader
findings.evidence: The RTL cannot load while active and requires all 460 row bits before phase commit. Actual replay therefore performs 794880 row accepts plus 1728 commits outside 835383 read issues; the serialized lower bound is 1631991 cycles before other endpoints.
findings.impact: M86 does not yet realize M78's next-phase-DMA overlap premise, so the 3/4/4/5 start spacing cannot readmit 1.409x or stand alone as module throughput.
findings.minimal_fix: Add ping-pong banks or a bounded DMA/compute schedule and publish total phase cycles including fill, commit, drain, and backpressure.

findings.title: Registered array semantics are not physical SRAM evidence
findings.evidence: bank_mem is behavioral RTL and the run compiles no SRAM macro; there is no DC/STA/SAIF/PTPX or macro read-during-write/inference report.
findings.impact: One-cycle VCS behavior does not establish macro timing, area, banking, power, or achievable frequency.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind eight same-capacity single-port SRAM macros or characterized wrappers, then run same-resource DC/STA and workload-linked power.

findings.title: Escape and downstream execution remain control placeholders
findings.evidence: The only actual escape returns a zero width-12 output; no bit-sparse fallback, accumulator, ordered heldout-use consumer, or end-to-end schedule is connected.
findings.impact: Lossless frontend transport is shown, not an executable accelerator module or accuracy-preserving cycle result.
findings.minimal_fix: Connect the exact escape fallback and accumulator/consumer, replay ordered heldout-use traffic, and account all cycles.

findings.title: Local issue guard checks only base_row
findings.evidence: issue_valid checks issue_base_row < ROWS but not every rotated issue_rows element. Frozen metadata audit keeps current inputs safe and the independent oracle found max row 459.
findings.impact: The frontend relies on upstream metadata invariants rather than a final local OOB guard.
findings.minimal_fix: Reduce-AND all eight row bounds into issue_valid and assert no issued row is out of range.

findings.title: Every phase writes 460 rows even when the terminal is shorter
findings.evidence: Actual terminals need 743731 rows, but the completion bitmap forces 794880 accepts, including 51149 zero-row writes (6.88 percent over the minimum).
findings.impact: Fixed full-image loading spends avoidable traffic and weakens precision-elastic staging gains.
findings.minimal_fix: Carry an authenticated terminal-row count and define implicit zero behavior above it, or zero only the final partial row.

findings.title: Backpressure coverage is deterministic and finite
findings.evidence: Production uses one LFSR over the final 128 phases; the independent bench adds a six-cycle full-FIFO hold but not exhaustive arbitrary stalls or reset/fault injection mid-transaction.
findings.impact: The tested FIFO conservation is strong but not a proof over all flow-control histories.
findings.minimal_fix: Add formal FIFO conservation/ordering properties and bounded arbitrary output_ready plus reset/fault campaigns.

scoped_go: GO for the one-cycle registered eight-bank array, depth-four FIFO, M85 mask, and M82 reconstruction functional milestone on the exact frozen inputs.
GO for using M86 as the next implementation substrate after fixing channel arbitration and adding a total-cycle loader schedule.
no_go: NO-GO for calling the behavioral arrays compiled SRAM macros.
NO-GO for M78 1.409x re-admission, any RTL/module/system speedup, FPS, energy, PPA, accuracy, DATE, or best-paper claim.

required_next_gate: Resolve simultaneous-valid arbitration and add assertions.
Replace full-460-row serialized refill with terminal-aware ping-pong loading or charge it in a bounded cycle schedule.
Connect real escape fallback and downstream accumulator/consumer.
Run same-resource SRAM-macro/DC/STA/SAIF/PTPX evidence before any performance admission.
